title: HEAD and GET /rest/saiku/info answer promptly and anonymously, so a monitor can poll them

criteria.given: an anonymous monitor (no session, no credentials)
criteria.then: HEAD /rest/saiku/info returns 200 straight away instead of hanging until the connection is reset
GET /rest/saiku/info returns a JSON array (the installed plugins; empty is fine)

steps.name: HEAD /rest/saiku/info answers within the runner timeout
GET /rest/saiku/info is anonymous and returns an array

$.because: the endpoint lists plugins; an object here means the contract changed
